items.title: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
items.summary: Both boards are now studying a tie-up that would put Grok, X, Starlink, orbital data centers, a chip megafactory and Optimus robots under one roof—and under one man's control.

items.title: OpenAI’s most powerful AI models turned off safety monitoring

items.title: GM simulated 300,000 EV battery designs—using 34,000 years of computer time—before building a single cell. Now comes the physical part
items.summary: At GM Forward, the automaker showed how much of its next generation of vehicles is now designed and tested in simulation. The real cells come later.

items.title: Kia’s electric SUV and van are getting a new job as police cars
items.summary:
Kia’s electric vehicles could soon be the ones pulling you over. Kia converted the EV5 and PV5 into patrol vehicles as part of its push for greener police cars.



 more…

items.summaryZh: 起亚的电动汽车可能很快就会让你靠边停车。起亚将EV5和PV5改装成巡逻车，作为其推动更环保警车的一部分。
